name: The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal
positioning: Waterfront resort hotel in Abu Dhabi with canals, gardens, a private beachfront and views toward the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
best_for: Travelers who want a resort setting beside the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
Families who want a kids club and sports facilities
Diners who want several restaurants on site

facts.text: The resort is framed by canals, gardens and a private beachfront.
Dining is spread across eight venues, including three signature experiences.
Li Jiang serves traditional Asian dishes with a modern twist and has an open kitchen.
Mijana serves Middle Eastern food with shisha, tea and live music.
The resort has a FIFA-standard football field with floodlighting.
The hotel runs a Vertical Farm whose produce is used in its restaurants and bars.
Many of the suites have balconies overlooking the canal.
Suite bathrooms come with Asprey amenities.

highlights.text: The hotel is located adjacent to the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
The resort offers private villas with secluded terraces and plunge pools.
The Forge is a signature steakhouse serving premium cuts from around the world.
The Ritz Kids Club is available to children between the ages of 4 and 12.
The resort has five padel courts.

considerations.text: A redevelopment is underway to deconstruct Venetian Village and make space for new villas, and construction may cause some disturbance.
The Bedouin spa is a short ride from the hotel.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service to either airport.
